name: Shirako (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shirako town emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shirako, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 December 1974.

features.role: Shirako town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
